Lines.Text: Introduction##^
It was the dawn of what many believed would be a golden age.#^
At long last the world had acheived lasting peace.#^^
Then an unimaginable threat emerged.##^^
As mankind had been squabbling amongst itself,#
A vast interstellar empire had been spreading it's influence across the the depths of space for ten millenia.#^^^
Bent on total conquest, ^
built on the broken backs of slaves ^
and maintained by mercilessness.##^^
Homeworld Orbital Patrol##^
H.O.P was rapidly established to combat this otherworldy threat.#^
Composed of a miraculous amalgamation of the world's greatest military and scientific resources;#
They were our only hope.##^
High Altitude Reconnaissance & Engagement##^
The H.A.R.E Project was conceived as a first line of defense against the alien invaders;#
A vangaurd against aspiring conquerors from beyond the stars.##^^
By intercepting the extraterrestial menace before they can establish a foothold,#
our chances of repelling the cosmic threat can be marginally improved.##^^
Your Mission##^
Assume control of an experimental H.A.R.E. Unit.#^
Patrol the exosphere for intrusions.#^
Exterminate all intruders with extreme prejudice.#
Good luck ^
...you'll need it!
